payout_quote: Become a tester of websites and apps and earn $3 - $30 per test. Each test lasts 5 to 60 minutes and is completed with your computer, tablet or smartphone. Most tests are 20 minutes where you earn $10... Tests (including those from your referral links) are only assigned to you if you match the client's specific demographic criteria. (Official Userfeel Tester FAQ, crawled 2026-09-23)
timing: Paid after your test is approved by the client; tests are assigned only when you match the client's demographic criteria
eligibility: Computer, tablet or smartphone; tests assigned only when you match the client's specific demographic criteria
steps: Register on userfeel.com and complete your tester profile
Accept test invitations that match your profile
Record your screen and voice while completing tasks, submit written answers
Get $10 per 20-minute test after client approval
catches: Test volume is irregular and demographic-gated - you may get several tests a week or none for weeks; this is not steady work
You are only paid if the client approves your test; low-effort feedback can be rejected unpaid
Longer tests (40-60 min) pay $20-$30 but are rarer
biggest_catch: Tests only arrive when you match a client's demographics - volume is unpredictable, so treat this as occasional $10 windfalls, not income you can schedule.
notes: DEMOTED by coordinator adjudication 2026-09-23: duplicate - same provider and same bonus mechanism already verified at R3445 (Userfeel, catalog). Original: Official Userfeel tester FAQ (userfeel.com/tester-faq, crawled 2026-09-23): earn $3-$30/test; most tests 20 min = $10. Repeatable per test. Distinct from TryMyUI/UserTesting.
maximize: Fill out every demographic field completely - tests are assigned purely on demographic match, so a sparse profile means zero invites. When a test arrives, do it the same day - invites go to many testers and fill fast. Narrate constantly and specifically while testing (what you like, what confuses you, why) - detailed feedback gets approved and re-invited; one-word answers get rejected unpaid.
